opening.argument: The presentation offers a direct method for obtaining Candy Crush gold bars and candies without payment, beginning with instructions to "select create modified APK file" and claiming that "you can buy as much as you want for free." These are not general cautions or hypothetical possibilities: the modified-application and in-app-emulation steps are presented as a repeatable way to add resources that ordinarily require payment, supported by screens showing zero-dollar purchase buttons and a later purchase-success message. A Facebook login screen is also visible, with fields for an email address or phone number and password. The available evidence does not establish that credentials were entered or transmitted, but that limitation does not change the central offer of unlimited in-app resources through Lucky Patcher and a modified application.

citations.quote: you can buy as much as you want for free
